title.value: #EEGManyLabs: Investigating the replicability of influential EEG experiments
title.justification: The title clearly encapsulates the main focus of the paper, which is a large-scale international effort to replicate influential EEG experiments.
title.quote: #EEGManyLabs: Investigating the replicability of influential EEG experiments

analysis.description: This paper discusses the #EEGManyLabs project, a large-scale international collaborative effort to assess the replicability of influential EEG studies. The project aims to test the reproducibility of key EEG findings through multi-laboratory collaborations.

type.justification: The paper describes a plan to conduct empirical replications of EEG experiments to assess replicability, focusing on the practical execution and analysis of experimental data.
type.quote: we have launched #EEGManyLabs, a large-scale international collaborative replication effort.

name.justification: The main aim is to investigate the replicability of EEG findings, which are integral to cognitive neuroscience studies of brain activity and cognition.
name.quote: Given this context, there is a need to address the replicability of cognitive neuroscience research.

name.justification: The paper's focus is on replicating studies using EEG to assess cognitive neuroscience findings.
name.quote: The #EEGManyLabs project aims to assess the replicability of a set of highly influential studies using electroencephalography (EEG).

name.justification: The paper connects EEG replicability issues with previous findings in psychology, and the replicable strategies derive partly from psychological sciences.
name.quote: Inspired by recent efforts from the psychological sciences...

name.justification: EEGlab is mentioned as a tool intended for advanced EEG processing, which is relevant to the studies being replicated.
